About this preview.

The scope and limits of the FloatSheets interactive frontend.

IN THIS NOTEPurpose.Simulated activity.Illustrative information.No production commitment.Use of the preview.Explore dashboard ↗
{01}

Purpose.

This site lets you explore proposed product mechanics with sample information and virtual balances. It is not a live exchange, broker, custody service, or offer to enter a financial transaction.

{02}

Simulated activity.

workspace orders, positions, deposits, staking, and nominations exist only in your local browser. They have no monetary value and do not create rights to assets, tokens, rewards, or future product access.

{03}

Illustrative information.

Market names, prices, balances, fees, capacity values, and chart history in the dashboard are fictional or illustrative. The research pages summarize supplied design specifications. The roadmap may change.

{04}

No production commitment.

This frontend does not confirm that contracts, data licenses, security reviews, jurisdiction checks, or live infrastructure have been implemented. A production launch would require separate operative terms and eligibility rules.

{05}

Use of the preview.

You may explore the interface and export your own local workspace activity. Do not enter secrets or rely on simulated outputs for real financial decisions.
